#!/bin/bash
set -eu
if [ "$#" -ne 3 ] && [ "$#" -ne 4 ]; then
  echo "usage: shortcut SOURCE_ID VIEW PART [--check-only]" >&2
  exit 64
fi
exec /home/uranus/miniforge3/envs/tlm_torch/bin/python -I -B -c 'from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib.util, sys
root = Path("/home/uranus/tinyLM")
path = root / "handoff/audit/hold_resolution_20261027_goalc/scoped_lossless_review_entry_v2.py"
if path.is_symlink() or hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper() != "72B5374D1099EFFEDF785B595D0711141441D6115E3D914EB387BA45BB9820BF":
    raise SystemExit("fixed lossless V2 entry bytes changed; no corpus read")
values = sys.argv[1:]
cohort = "root12_independent_admission_counter_v1"
ident, view, part = values[:3]
if ident.isdigit():
    ident = "expanded_train:" + ident
sys.argv = [str(path), "--cohort", cohort, "--source-id", ident, "--view", view, "--part", part]
if len(values) == 4:
    if values[-1] != "--check-only":
        raise SystemExit("only --check-only may follow the fixed arguments")
    sys.argv.append("--check-only")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("fixed_lossless_entry_v2", path)
entry = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(entry)
entry.cli(root, "context_controls", {"path":"handoff/audit/hold_resolution_20261027_goalc/LOSSLESS_REVIEW_READER_SCOPE_V2.json","sha256":"316F2E46B2D84090FE03EAA2C2BD03774E690DA5CFEBD37D40E2AFBB795EAEB6","bytes":3889})' "$@"
